+const { testPluginOptionsSchema, ObjectSchema } = require("./packages/gatsby-plugin-utils/src")
+
+it(`partial single value`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) =>
+    Joi.object({ str: Joi.string(), nb: Joi.number(), toVerify: Joi.boolean() })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { toVerify: `invalid` })
+  expect(r).toEqual({ isValid: false, errors: [`"toVerify" must be a boolean`] })
+})
+
+it(`partial multiple values`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) =>
+    Joi.object({ str: Joi.string(), nb: Joi.number(), toVerify: Joi.boolean() })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { nb: `x`, toVerify: `y` })
+  expect(r.isValid).toBe(false)
+  expect(r.errors).toEqual([`"nb" must be a number`, `"toVerify" must be a boolean`])
+})
+
+it(`required present as undefined`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) => Joi.object({ trackingId: Joi.string().required() })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { trackingId: undefined })
+  expect(r.errors).toEqual([`"trackingId" is required`])
+})
+
+it(`ignores absent required fields`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) =>
+    Joi.object({ trackingId: Joi.string().required(), other: Joi.boolean() })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { other: true })
+  expect(r).toEqual({ isValid: true, errors: [] })
+})
+
+it(`array item errors concatenated`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) => Joi.object({ arr: Joi.array().items(Joi.string()) })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { arr: [1, 2, 3] })
+  expect(r.errors).toEqual([
+    `"arr" "[0]" must be a string. "[1]" must be a string. "[2]" must be a string`,
+  ])
+})
+
+it(`valid returns empty`, async () => {
+  const schema = ({ Joi }) => Joi.object({ toVerify: Joi.boolean() })
+  const r = await testPluginOptionsSchema(schema, { toVerify: false })
+  expect(r).toEqual({ isValid: true, errors: [] })
+})
